hero.headline: Strengthening Candler from the Inside Out
hero.body: The Foundry provides faculty, students, and alumni with the resources and opportunities that allow teaching and preaching ministries to thrive.

panel-1.quote: The Foundry sets Candler apart from other theological schools by showing prospective students a new way of imagining public theology.

panel-2.quote: The Foundry's unique ministry helps set Candler apart from other schools.
